method: built-in image_gen; whole new native image per version

toolArgs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE wholly NEW, high-quality real-camera aerial PHOTOGRAPH-LOOKING illustration of Tivoli Gardens, Copenhagen. Native landscape1536x1024,3:2. Original complete new scene, no painting, drawing, miniature or glossy3D rendering. All input photographs are ONLY architectural/ride-structure references: Image1 for the Japanese pagoda and red steel coaster shapes, Image2 for Nimb's white Moorish architecture and artificial rocky mountain, Image3 for Himmelskibet steel lattice mast, spoke crown, long suspension chains and outward swinging seats. Do NOT copy their camera positions, people, text, framing, leaf foreground or ground-level view.

LOCKED NEW CAMERA: pilot's eye at about40m above ground on the NORTHEAST side of the Tivoli lake, approximately55.6744N12.5712E, looking SOUTHWEST heading235degrees, tilted20degrees DOWN, horizontal field of view about80degrees. This is a broad oblique aerial view, not a topdown map and not a lake-level photograph. Horizon in upper part of frame; Copenhagen low-rise roofs on distant horizon, no skyscrapers. The foreground lake is central, about110m ahead. Reconstruct this intended spatial composition, not a collage of separately placed landmarks.

LANDMARK LAYOUT seen from this camera, all as a coherent real park with leafy trees and paths between: (1) Tivoli lake and shore lantern rows in foreground/centre. (2) On lake's far/south shore LEFT OF CENTRE at about25%image width, the JAPANESE PAGODA: recognizable dark red open timber multi-tier pavilion, greenish upturned pagoda roofs, tall thin finial, four storeys, approximately24m,175m away. (3) At centre/slightlyright, around54%width and310m distance, RUTSCHEBANEN traditional wooden coaster with gray artificial rocky mountain, modest~12m high, not a giant natural mountain. (4) The SINGLE tallest landmark is HIMMELSKIBET: slender80m steel lattice swing-ride mast around43%width,280m away, spoke-crown with many long fine chains and small seats swinging outward. Its FULL tip must remain inside frame; do not confuse it with a Ferris wheel, drop tower or squat ride. (5) On RIGHT around69%width and320m distance, NIMB is a low long WHITE MOORISH PALACE with detailed arched windows, little slender minaret-like turrets and pale green onion domes. (6) PANTOMIME THEATRE only at the EXTREME RIGHT EDGE, around93%width, its Chinese-style roof visible through trees; its stage/curtain is out of view. (7) DAEMONEN coaster at EXTREME LEFT, around7%width, red steel track loops/curves and silver supports,180m away, NO dragon or other themed sculptures. No unrelated giant rides invented. All landmarks relatively distant in a full park panorama; natural scale, abundant real trees and winding paths, coherent ground plane.

MATERIALS: honest camera optics and natural nonrepeating textures in water, foliage, stone, wood and plaster. Fine directional ripples and physically plausible reflections, no engraved/stamped wave pattern, global canvas grain, plastic foliage or oversharpened microtexture. No heavy orange wash, HDR halo, vignette or decorative border. NO text, signs, letters, logos, Tivoli word, advertisements, watermark, UI or readable faces. If people appear, only tiny distant anonymous silhouettes on paths. No modern skyscrapers or invented skyline. Do not show Queen Margrethe's2024 blue-green theatre curtain; simplest: stage/curtain entirely hidden. Single coherent full photograph-like image, no montage.

DAY VERSION A1: clear bright SUMMER AFTERNOON, western sunlight about35degrees elevation, blue sky with a few natural light clouds, warm neutral daylight without an orange filter. GREEN summer trees. All rides operating, Himmelskibet seats visibly swing outward on fine chains. Small distant human silhouettes only. Lake water naturally reflects sky and surrounding park. No illuminated neon or excessive glowing bulbs during daytime. Make the spatial layout and recognisable buildings readable in natural light.

Time20–30minutes after sunset in SUMMER, deep luminous BLUE sky still visibly blue, not black night. Thousands of SMALL WARM-WHITE incandescent-like POINT bulbs outline the buildings, Nimb domes, wooden coaster and Himmelskibet mast. Japanese pagoda eaves carry many small COLOURED point bulbs.
